title: Show your work
subtitle: Live compliance posture, a tamper-evident audit chain, and an honest model register

steps.caption: Trust Center: compliance posture aggregated from the running system, not a PDF. Amber is amber; an all-green screen should be trusted less.
Flight Recorder: a SHA-256 hash chain over every audit row. Alter or delete one and the chain breaks. Every question Sage was asked is in there, and every refusal.
Model Governance: each model, its version, and whether it has been validated. The forecast model says "untrained". The validated one is the deterministic score that drives escalation.
Pilot Scorecard: how the pilot will be measured. Shadow-mode episodes, adjudication, outcomes, denominators included.
